answer: Trust as plumbing: pick 20 long-running seed IDs and push trust outward through attestations as a max-flow, each edge a pipe carrying at most 1 unit. An ID earns in proportion to the flow reaching it. A farm of 1,000 clones can attest each other all day, but if it hooks into the honest graph by only 5 edges, the whole hollow block gets 5 units, like 1,000 faucets fed by one half-inch line. Pressure is at its zenith at the seeds and thins along each vine of the graph. Pipe sizes are my proposal, untested.
